stem:
During a solar eclipse, Parul's class plans how to watch.

Which statement about safety is correct?

options.text: Looking directly at the Sun without proper protection is unsafe.
Looking at the Sun's reflection in a hand mirror is safe.
Looking directly when only a thin crescent of the Sun remains is safe.
Looking through proper eclipse-viewing glasses is unsafe.

teacher.key_rationale: Direct viewing without proper protection is unsafe. A hand-mirror reflection is not safe viewing. A thin crescent is still unsafe. Proper eclipse-viewing glasses make direct viewing safe when used correctly.
